name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Adopt Qwen2.5-72B for EXCAVA. It’s the cheapest 128K-context model with proven performance, giving us more runs per dollar than Llama 3.3 70B while keeping the long-context advantage. The trade-off is slightly lower raw capability, but the cost savings let us run more experiments to squeeze out that 0.5% gain.

name: Torque
text: Qwen2.5-72B’s 128K claim is vendor marketing—our tests show it collapses past 32K, so the long-context advantage is a myth. Llama 3.3 70B’s 128K also failed in our last test, leaving us with no proven high-context model. The real risk is wasting compute on a broken capability; we should benchmark Mistral Large 2 or Command R+ 104B for 128K first—if either holds, we adopt it.
